name: PKCS#12 Parser
description: Read the certificate, private key and CA chain out of a PKCS#12 container.

hints.sensitive: The result **contains the private key**: make sure this environment is trusted, and note that it is discarded when you leave the page.
hints.passphrase: A wrong passphrase reports "passphrase incorrect"; a damaged container reports "invalid PKCS#12" — the two are never confused.
hints.base64: The container is binary; paste it as base64 or hex and the tool detects the encoding.

faq.a: No, it only reads it. Use the password changer to change the passphrase.

faq.q: Why does the result include a private key?
faq.a: The container stores the private key by design; you can copy it, but handle it carefully.

faq.q: Can a container without a passphrase be parsed?
